description: A Nuxt app with a real-time Courier notification inbox: a server route that mints a scoped JWT and the Vue CourierInbox component.
rules: Use @trycourier/courier on the server and read COURIER_API_KEY from the environment. Never hard-code a key or send it to the browser.
Mint the inbox JWT in a Nuxt server route with client.auth.issueToken, taking the user id from the session, never from the request.
Scope tokens as user_id:<id> inbox:read:messages inbox:write:events and always set expires_in, because omitting it mints a token that never expires.
Render CourierInbox from @trycourier/courier-vue and call courier.shared.signIn in onMounted. ClientOnly isn't needed.
Send inbox messages with client.send.message and routing { method: 'single', channels: ['inbox'] } to the same user_id.
